aviator_crash_intro_text: Aviator from {name} quickly became a gambling fan favorite thanks to its simple mechanics, exciting gameplay, and the chance to win jaw-dropping amounts of cash. In this article, we'll take a deep dive into the various aspects of this game, from its rules to some different strategies, in order to provide you with a full understanding of how to make the most out of this entertainment masterclass.
aviator_crash_play_text: Aviator is an interactive simulator game in which players place bets on the outcome of a flight by a virtual plane. The object of the game is to withdraw your money before the plane flies off the screen.
aviator_crash_rule_1: {span}Bets:{/span} You could place one or two bets at a time, allowing you to switch up your strategy and boost your chances of winning.
aviator_crash_rule_2: {span}Multiplier:{/span} The whole time the plane is in flight, the multiplier will increase. Starting at {minCoef} and potentially increasing infinitely, it will stop at a random moment.
aviator_crash_rule_3: {span}Withdrawing your winnings:{/span} The key is to make sure you withdraw your winnings before the plane disappears. Otherwise, you'll lose your stake.
aviator_crash_rules_list_title: The rules of Aviator are fairly simple, making it accessible even for new players:
aviator_crash_step_1: {span}Set your stake:{/span} Before each round begins, you'll need to select an amount for your stake. This is usually done using the handy interface, where you can enter the amount you want to bet or select one of the available options.
aviator_crash_step_2: {span}Round start:{/span} Once all bets have been placed, the round will begin. A plane will appear on the screen and begin to gain altitude. The higher it climbs, the greater the winning multiplier.
aviator_crash_step_3: {span}Withdraw your money:{/span} You need to press the "Cash out" button to determine your winnings - before the plane flies off the screen. If you don't withdraw your winnings in time, your bet loses.
aviator_crash_strategies_1: {span}Small stakes:{/span} Place small bets and withdraw your winnings while the multiplier is still low. This strategy minimizes the risk and helps you keep your balance stable.
aviator_crash_strategies_2: {span}High multiplier:{/span} Stop the game when the multiplier gets high, but be prepared for the bigger risk this entails. This strategy could bring big dividends, or you could end up losing all your cash.
aviator_crash_strategies_4: {span}Analyze the stats:{/span} Study the stats from previous rounds to see which multipliers come up most often. This will help you make more informed decisions.
aviator_crash_strategies_5: {span}Keep your cool:{/span} It's important to maintain a level head and not get caught up in all the excitement. Set limits on your winnings and losses to make sure you don't lose more than you planned to.

m_effect_text_72: Mukhazhan, what do you do and how long have you been betting?
m_effect_text_73: I live in Almaty, I run a small business. I've been betting for about 3.5 – 4 years.
m_effect_text_75: I've been with {name} for about a year and a half. I chose this company purely because they offer you freedom of choice. I mean a freedom of choice in betting – that is, unlimited accumulators and huge returns.
m_effect_text_76: There’s the freedom to bet on the same team in different competitions and rounds. I like the freedom of choice. I think it's right. That's why I'm with {name}.
m_effect_text_77: Why 44 selections? Weren't you afraid? What made you bet on so many selections?
m_effect_text_78: I was thinking, I'm 44 now, and the fact that 44 selections paid out... I don't think it's a coincidence. I like big accumulators. If you win, you win big.
m_effect_text_79: If you think back to that day, when the last event – the last match – took place and you realized that you'd won and bagged a huge payout – how did you feel? Did you wake up the whole house?
m_effect_text_7_1: The previous winner of {span}{name}'s golden champion's ring{/span} and the {sum} prize fund was:
m_effect_text_80: Honestly, at first I didn't believe it, because it didn't feel like it happening to me. I woke my wife up and showed her everything, because the money instantly appeared in my betting account. I was overflowing with joy, of course.
m_effect_text_81: My wife runs an animal charity in Almaty. Maybe now, if we have enough money, we'll turn our attention to Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan, as it's a big city. So I told her that if I ever won, the first thing we'd do is help out our little brothers in need. That's why the happiness was immeasurable – specifically for this reason.
m_effect_text_82: Something for our players: do you have a winning betting formula?
m_effect_text_83: Well, firstly, I'd like to wish everyone who decides to bet on sports good luck. I think my biggest motivator was my desire to help animals and people in need, when they need it. So I'd advise players to go in thinking not just how a win could benefit them, but also how they would share it with someone else – I think this is the secret to my success.

Its red and blue colors embody passion and a desire to win, and its home ground, the Groupama Stadium, attracts tens of thousands of fans who live and breathe the game. At the beginning of the 21st century, Lyon made history by winning seven consecutive Ligue 1 titles, a record that still commands respect. The club regularly competed in the UEFA Champions League, and its academy has nurtured a galaxy of world-class stars, including Karim Benzema and Alexandre Lacazette. Today, Lyon is undergoing a period of renewal: the team is building a new squad, focusing on young players, and remains one of the most recognizable brands in French football.

responsible_gamb_16: We talk openly about the warning signs of problem gambling and ensure all our players have access to the information they need if they feel the necessity to seek help.
responsible_gamb_17: Our gaming environment is based on three core principles: real justice, real safety and real prevention.
responsible_gamb_18: We allow our online players to set their limits, including in relation to their spending. These can be either self-exclusions on a voluntary basis or monetary limits on the game. You can easily request a reduction in these limits at any time.
responsible_gamb_19: We do everything to ensure that the client gets a complete understanding of our services and the risks associated with gambling for money:
responsible_gamb_2: Gambling is primarily entertainment. Unfortunately, not everyone can control emotions when it comes to money. The desire to get your losses back or hit the jackpot can become an obsession.
responsible_gamb_20: we talk in detail about how bets, promotions and bonuses work;
responsible_gamb_21: we do not use advertising techniques that help to attract minors and people who are easily suggestible;
responsible_gamb_22: we warn you about the possibility of losing.
responsible_gamb_23: We expect our clients to have a sensible approach to betting on sports and other events. In a responsible gaming environment, the player themselves must make sure they are aware of all the risks.
responsible_gamb_25: Knows that gambling is for entertainment only
responsible_gamb_26: Does not use gambling as the main source of income
responsible_gamb_27: Takes regular breaks between gaming sessions
responsible_gamb_28: Sets a certain time limit for gambling on a daily, weekly or monthly basis and sticks to it
responsible_gamb_29: Sets a specific budget for the day, week or month and sticks to it
responsible_gamb_3: Betting should be fun. If you get frustrated, worry about the results, or bet continuously for a long time, this may be a sign that you need to take a break and rethink the impact of betting on your life.
responsible_gamb_30: Plays only with money he can afford to lose and treats any money lost as the cost of entertainment
responsible_gamb_32: Our advertising is aimed exclusively at adults who do not have serious psychological problems.
responsible_gamb_34: Does not allow minors to play and uses all available means to verify that clients have reached the age of majority in accordance with the laws of their country.
responsible_gamb_35: We regularly check player profiles to ensure the information they provide is correct.
responsible_gamb_36: If doubts arise about their reliability, additional verification may be carried out. For example, {name} has the right to request notarized paper copies of documents or video identification. For standard verification, a photo of your ID and payment instrument is usually sufficient.
responsible_gamb_37: Unfortunately, verification does not guarantee a 100% result when a minor player has access to other people’s personal data. And if this information is provided voluntarily by adults, it is very difficult to do anything. The protection of minors largely depends on their family members. If you share a computer with a minor, you must be sure they do not have access to your logins, passwords and bank details. Teenagers may use documents and financial details of their parents, so it is important to be attentive to their hobbies. To restrict access to online gambling for minors, you can install special programs, such as Cyber Patrol or NetNanny.
responsible_gamb_39: Every player must know the basic rules of responsible gambling to organize their game process. Their observance will help protect against the negative consequences of gambling addiction. So that the game brings only pleasure, please do not abuse it, observe and follow the following rules of responsible gambling:
responsible_gamb_40: If you decide to gamble, do it solely for fun. Do not go to your favorite online casino when you are sad, angry, lonely or looking to make money.
responsible_gamb_41: Before starting to play, it is crucial to understand that the game should not be considered as a source of main income or as a means of getting out of debt and participating in gambling does not solve financial, social or emotional problems. If gambling no longer gives you pleasure, ask yourself why you still play.
responsible_gamb_42: Treat the money you lose as the cost of your entertainment. Consider any winnings as a bonus. Measure the success of a gaming session by how much fun you had, not how much money you won.
responsible_gamb_43: Set a limit of funds you can afford to spend on gambling and stick to it.
responsible_gamb_44: Set a time limit and stick to it. Decide how much time you want to devote to gambling. Stop playing when you reach the time limit, whether you win or lose.
responsible_gamb_45: In the event of a loss, you should not try to win the lost money back immediately. The sooner you try to recover your losses, the more money you will spend.
responsible_gamb_46: You must be ready to lose because the probability is quite high. Participation in gambling can lead to loss of funds. Manage your expectations. It makes sense to start a new session with the expectation of losing to avoid disappointment or the temptation to continue the game despite exceeding your budget.
responsible_gamb_47: Always work on finding and maintaining balance in your life. If other aspects of your lifestyle are well balanced (you are happy at work, maintain healthy relationships, and devote time to self-improvement), you are less likely to feel the need to indulge in gambling. These are habits that can have sad consequences. Gambling should not replace friends, family, work or other useful activities.
responsible_gamb_48: Be aware of the many myths about gambling that can mislead you into thinking that it is safe to continue gambling even if you have exceeded your limits. The belief that your luck will change if you continue playing after a failing streak is an example of one of them. Another myth is to play multiple games simultaneously to increase your chances of winning big.
responsible_gamb_50: Do not use gambling as a way to cope with emotional or physical pain. Gambling for reasons other than entertainment can lead to problems.
responsible_gamb_51: Familiarize yourself with the signs of gambling addiction and pay close attention to your health. If you feel that you need help, do not hesitate to seek it from loved ones and specialists.
responsible_gamb_53: Representatives of the American Psychiatric Association point out signs of gambling addiction, which can be the manifestation of four or more symptoms from this list within the last year:
responsible_gamb_54: Persistent and repeated need to gamble, causing clinically significant impairment, expressed by at least four signs present in the gambler within 12 months;
responsible_gamb_55: The need to increase the size of bets to achieve the desired thrill;
responsible_gamb_56: Anxiety and irritation when trying to shorten the game time or leave the game;
responsible_gamb_57: Unsuccessful attempts to control your gambling addiction, reduce your gaming time or quit playing;
responsible_gamb_58: Preoccupation with gambling (e.g., constantly thinking back to past gaming experiences, thinking about how to gain an advantage in the game or to find funds to play, and planning the next opportunity to play);
responsible_gamb_59: Many people, weakened by games, feel depressed (feelings of helplessness, guilt, anxiety, depression);
responsible_gamb_60: Returning a few days after the loss to win your money back (recover your losses);
responsible_gamb_61: Lying to hide the level of involvement in the game;
responsible_gamb_62: Gambling jeopardizes relationships with loved ones, work, education or career prospects;
responsible_gamb_63: In case of lack of funds due to gambling, a person switches the solution of these problems to others;
responsible_gamb_64: Gaming behaviour is not explained by manic disorder.
responsible_gamb_66: {name} recommends that clients ask themselves a few simple questions from time to time:
responsible_gamb_67: Do you have difficulty controlling your gaming budget?
responsible_gamb_68: Do you borrow money to place bets?
responsible_gamb_69: Have you started to have disagreements with family and friends over the cost of placing bets?
responsible_gamb_70: Is your maximum deposit constantly growing?
responsible_gamb_71: Have you begun to pay less attention to other usual interests and hobbies?
responsible_gamb_72: Are you downplaying your spending and how passionate you are about the game?
responsible_gamb_73: Do you feel depressed due to gaming failures?
responsible_gamb_75: If the answer to most questions is yes, you should consider stopping or at least switching to safer gambling. It's never too late to admit addiction.
responsible_gamb_76: If the problem with gambling control is too serious, you cannot do without professional help. There are many international (GamblingTherapy, Be GambleAware) and local organizations that support people with severe gambling addiction. It is easy to find contacts of such communities in your country in open sources. In any case, everything depends on the player’s will. Until they admit the problem, it will be difficult to help.
responsible_gamb_77: Remember that you should never gamble when you are under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
responsible_gamb_78: Self-exclusion: how to pause the game
responsible_gamb_79: Self-exclusion from gambling sometimes becomes the only way to deal with the problem. First of all, you need to withdraw money from your account. Of course, nothing prevents you from making a deposit if you really want to bet, but this will at least delay the process of returning to the game and give you time to think. You can also block access to the site in your PC and mobile devices browser. The support of a supervisor who regularly checks whether their charge has any gambling expenses is very helpful.
responsible_gamb_80: Self-exclusion from bookmakers is the most radical method of restriction. If you don't want to take time out, you can plan your allowable monthly betting expenses and allocate a specific time to play on the platform. By setting a budget for your bets, you will remain in control of your finances.
responsible_gambling_mn_age_limit_explan: Only individuals aged 21 or over can bet on sports. {name} strictly monitors the ages of its customers and does not allow underage gambling. We don't advertise our products and services to minors, and we don't encourage them to engage in betting or gambling
responsible_gambling_mn_benefits_vs_risk: By following some simple rules for gambling responsibly, you are making sure that you have fun, win some cash, and earn valuable gifts when you bet on sports on the {name} platform. On the other hand, if you gamble irresponsibly, this could lead to an addiction to betting, psychological problems, a negative impact on your work and personal life, and other undesirable effects
responsible_gambling_mn_company_commitme: At {name}, we care deeply about the well-being of our users and make the utmost effort to provide our customers with a safe and secure experience while interacting with our betting platform. Responsible gambling is one of the key values held by {name} and we therefore place great importance on it.
responsible_gambling_mn_financial_limit_: We recommend that you set yourself a financial limit for how much you bet and stick to it, so you don't become addicted to gambling and betting. Set a reasonable upper limit for your stake, and then you won't lose too much if your bet is unsuccessful
responsible_gambling_mn_income_source_ex: Sports betting is all about having fun, being entertained, supporting your favorite team, and winning a certain amount of money, but it should never be your main source of income
responsible_gambling_mn_limits_intro: {name} lets you set your own responsible gambling preferences with self-restriction periods and reality checks.
responsible_gambling_mn_loss_tolerance: Place bets that you can afford to lose
responsible_gambling_mn_loss_tolerance_e: Even a sure bet on a favorite might not win, so only bet money that you can afford to lose. If you do lose, don't try to win your stake back. It's better to cool off, analyze your decisions, and place a bet later, in line with all the rules for gambling responsibly.
responsible_gambling_mn_no_borrowing: Don't take out loans to bet
responsible_gambling_mn_no_borrowing_exp: Always bet within your means. Try not to take on debt or credit to place bets, and if you have thought about making this decision, we suggest you think twice. Remember: debt's easy to get into, but hard to get out of
responsible_gambling_mn_no_income_source: Don't make betting your main source of income
responsible_gambling_mn_reality_check: With reality checks, you can set a timer for your gaming session. Once the time is up, a pop-up notification will appear. This is a feature for customers who find themselves losing touch with reality because they spend far too long on the platform to help them manage their time. You can select any time period that suits you, and disable this feature as you like, without having to get in touch with the Customer Support team
responsible_gambling_mn_self_exclusion: Self-restriction periods allow you to temporarily disable any account activity, including deposits, bets, bonuses, and mailings, for a specific amount of time. You can choose the most appropriate period of time: a day, week, or month
responsible_gambling_mn_self_exclusion_e: When a self-restriction period ends, you'll automatically be able to use your account for bets, deposits, and other activities. You can also deactivate the self-restriction period before it ends by contacting our Customer Support team.
responsible_gambling_mn_sober_play: Betting is only safe with a clear mind
responsible_gambling_mn_sober_play_expla: Avoid sports betting if you're feeling depressed or tired, and also if you're under the influence of alcohol, drugs or other banned substances. To be successful at betting, you need to analyse all the available player and team data, have in-depth knowledge of the sport, and little bit of luck. Anything that clouds your mind will only hinder you when it comes to placing that winning bet
responsible_gambling_mn_support_advice: Always follow the rules for responsible gambling and minimize potentials risks. If you already have an addiction, acknowledge it and address it. The {name} Customer Support team will respond to any of your queries about responsible gambling and help you to activate whichever self-restriction feature is appropriate for you.
responsible_gambling_mn_timer_pauses: Stay mindful with a timer and breaks
responsible_gambling_mn_timer_pauses_exp: In My Account, you can set a self-restriction period, during which any account activity will be disabled. You can also set yourself a maximum time limit for how long you play by setting the corresponding timer in your reality check settings.
